title: N-07 Scheduler tick and dispatch: input and output records
description: Book 1.1.0. Inputs: the tick:scheduler entity (../N-06/record.schema.json#/$defs/tick), the dispatchable rows of the tickets table (the ticket shape ../N-18/record.schema.json#/$defs/ticket) and the leases table (../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/lease_row). Outputs: dispatch (written by GrantDispatch in one Commit with the reserved lease and the ticket transition; its body is ../../shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/dispatch_body and N-13, N-14 and N-15 $ref this def, never a projection), dispatch.refused, budget.held and the sched:tick entity (tick_done). Every record extends base, the shared committed envelope. The operation key rides on the Commit request (shared/contracts.xml#operation-keys), never in the record. Times are UTC strings 2006-01-02T15:04:05Z.

base.description: The shared committed envelope (shared/state-store.schema.json#/$defs/committed_envelope: id, at, kind, code, node and seq) plus the ticket and attempt this node's records name. The operation key and the lease fence are fields of the Commit request (shared/contracts.schema.json#/$defs/commit_request), not of the record. N-08, N-09 and N-10 $ref this def.

dispatch.description: The dispatch record: the shared envelope plus the one dispatch body. unevaluatedProperties false keeps every consumer on one shape: a field that is not in the envelope or in contracts dispatch_body is refused here and in N-13, N-14 and N-15, which $ref this def.

dispatch_refused.description: The address check failed before any lease was reserved: nothing is granted and no attempt is charged; the ticket stays dispatchable and is held with reason refused until the repository is fixed. Latched once per (ticket, phase, attempt, reason).

budget_held.description: A dispatch held because a budget of shared/retry-budget.xml#budgets is spent: per ticket (seat USD, pods per unit) or per UTC day (seat USD, pod minutes). A hold, not a refusal: nothing is granted and the next tick re-examines; latched once per (scope, ticket or day, measure) so N-28 posts one card.

unit.description: the suite unit whose pod count is spent, for ticket_pods_per_unit

tick_done.description: The sched:tick entity, compare-and-swap written every tick; registered entity-only (shared/contracts.xml#entity-only), so it writes no record; version grows.

conflicts.description: Commits refused 409 (entity version) or 412 (precondition) and read back

snapshot_ok.description: false when the store read timed out and counts are unknown
